dataset: Main benchmark: N=744 test pairs, 13 programs

methodology.ci: Bootstrap, 1000 resamples, seed=42, clustered by base program

exception_fraction_only.note: BEST SINGLE FEATURE — defines minimum bar for SBG

sbg_v5_identity_full.note: V5 with invariant_identity + temporal + state; B07 pipeline
sbg_v5_identity_full.rq1_status: H0 NOT REJECTED — SBG V5 < exception_fraction

H1.note: Inversion: SP causes larger structural change

H2.note: exception_frac and AST both beat SBG

H3.note: SP-2 AUROC=0.259 before V5; V5 improves but benchmark not re-run

H12.note: 20% output-free; 93.3% is output oracle, not SBG

regression_evaluation_corrected.note: Previous 93.3% was output oracle, not SBG. Corrected to 20.0% for output-free predictor.

real_world_pilot.note: N=12 too small for strong claims; CI width = 0.500 covers random baseline

v5_identity_comparison.note: Identity normalization helps on DEV (+0.100) but test improvement is marginal (+0.011)

RQ2.question: Does V5 identity normalization improve SP-2 rename robustness?
RQ2.result: YES on unit tests (12/12) and DEV (+0.100 AUROC). Test improvement marginal (+0.011).
RQ2.verdict: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED — unit tests pass; aggregate test improvement small

RQ3.question: What is honest SBG detection rate on regression corpus?
RQ3.verdict: ANSWERED — previous result was output oracle, not SBG

RQ4.question: Does SBG above chance on real-world bugs (pilot)?
RQ4.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE — signal present but N insufficient for statistical test

RQ5.question: Does multi-dimensional genome add incremental info beyond exception_frac?
RQ5.result: NO on aggregate (delta=-0.042). Some individual features have unique info.
RQ5.verdict: H0 NOT REJECTED for full model. Individual features (call_bigrams, coverage) have marginal unique info.

RQ6.question: Does SBG-V5-identity beat exception_frac on hard-negative pairs?
RQ6.result: NOT DIRECTLY MEASURED with output-free predictor. Previous oracle result (12/12) was output oracle.
RQ6.verdict: UNMEASURED — requires running output-free predictor on 12 hard-negative pairs (infrastructure gap)

key_negative_findings: SBG V5 full pipeline AUROC=0.551 < exception_fraction AUROC=0.593 on test split
DEV AUROC=0.488 (below chance) raises generalization concerns
Output-free regression detection = 20.0% (corrected from previous 93.3% which was output oracle)
Silent bugs (invisible to exception+volume): SBG detects 0/10; output oracle detects 9/10
Multi-dimensional genome adds negative incremental value vs best single feature
key_positive_findings: H9: Execution resolves structural-semantic inversion (survives Holm-Bonferroni; p<0.01)
V5 identity normalization improves DEV AUROC from 0.488 to 0.588 (+0.100)
Hard-negative pairs: output oracle 12/12 (but this is output-based, not SBG distance)
Pilot: SBG AUROC=0.800 on QuixBugs-style programs (CI wide; N=12)
SBG is above noise floor on test split (permutation p=0.01)
